name: agent_launch
title: Launch an agent
description: Use to hand a task to an agent in another harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) that the operator allowed: it starts the agent in `working_dir`, its own existing worktree under the operator's worktrees root, with `brief` as its first prompt, and returns the session id, the agent's id and a basemind thread both of you are members of. Every approval the agent asks for is denied unless the operator's policy allows it; nothing here can allow one. Limits are clamped to the operator's caps; a refusal is a stable code. Example: {"harness":"claude","brief":"Review src/store.rs for races","working_dir":"review-store"}

brief.description: The agent's first prompt, at most 1 MiB, not starting with `/`.

working_dir.description: The agent's own existing worktree, relative to the operator's worktrees root.

model.description: The model, for Claude Code or Codex.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, for Claude Code or Codex.

max_turns.description: Turns the session may run, lowered to the operator's cap.

wall_time_s.description: Seconds the session may run, lowered to the operator's cap.

name: agent_stop
title: Stop a launched agent
description: Use to stop an agent you launched with agent_launch, by the `session` id it returned; agents it launched stop with it. Stopping a finished session changes nothing. Example: {"session":1}
